title: The Wind Changed the Design
summaryZh: 強風破壞了屋頂示範區，團隊在主管視察前選擇誠實面對失敗，並把現場損害轉化成改善安全、維護與責任分工的設計資料。

sentences.text: Early Monday morning, before most employees arrived, Sofia received a message from Ravi asking her to inspect what strong winds had done to the roof over the weekend.
sentences.zh: 星期一一早，多數員工都還沒抵達時，Sofia 收到 Ravi 的訊息，請她查看週末強風對屋頂造成的影響。

sentences.text: Strong winds over the weekend had pushed one folding table across the rooftop and overturned every empty planter.
sentences.zh: 週末的強風吹得一張折疊桌橫越屋頂，也吹倒了所有空花盆。

sentences.text: Mint plants lay on their sides, with dark soil scattered across the gray surface far beyond the demonstration corner.
sentences.zh: 薄荷盆栽倒在一旁，深色土壤越過示範區角落，散落在灰色屋頂表面很遠的地方。

sentences.text: A cardboard information board had disappeared, and three chairs were pressed against the safety wall.
sentences.zh: 一塊紙板說明牌不見了，三張椅子則被吹到緊貼安全牆。

sentences.text: No one had been hurt, but the scene made their cheerful photographs seem dishonest.
sentences.zh: 沒有人受傷，但眼前的景象讓他們先前那些愉快照片顯得不真實。

sentences.text: Director Chen was scheduled to inspect the space and eat lunch there in four hours.
sentences.zh: Chen 主管預定四小時後來視察這個空間，並在這裡吃午餐。

sentences.text: June arrived carrying cleaning supplies and stopped silently when she saw the damage.
sentences.zh: June 帶著清潔用品抵達，一看到損害便沉默地停下腳步。

sentences.text: Their demonstration, built after a week of work, seemed to have failed before its official presentation even began.
sentences.zh: 他們花了一週打造的示範區，似乎在正式展示開始前就已經失敗了。

sentences.text: June suggested clearing everything away and showing the director only the pictures from Friday.
sentences.zh: June 建議把一切清走，只向主管展示星期五拍的照片。

sentences.text: They could explain that bad weather had forced them to move the trial indoors.
sentences.zh: 他們可以解釋惡劣天氣迫使團隊把試用活動移到室內。

sentences.text: Sofia understood the temptation, because the original corner had looked welcoming for one calm afternoon.
sentences.zh: Sofia 理解這個誘惑，因為原本的角落至少在那個平靜的下午看來十分舒適。

sentences.text: However, hiding the damage would also hide the most useful result of their experiment.
sentences.zh: 然而，隱瞞損害也會掩蓋這場實驗最有用的結果。

sentences.text: Ravi agreed and, before anyone began cleaning, photographed where each object had moved for their records.
sentences.zh: Ravi 表示同意，並在任何人開始清理前，為團隊紀錄拍下每件物品被吹到的位置。

sentences.text: The tallest items had traveled farthest, while the low wooden boxes had barely shifted.
sentences.zh: 最高的物品被吹得最遠，而低矮的木箱幾乎沒有移動。

sentences.text: The folding table had moved because nobody had closed it and stored it after Friday's setup.
sentences.zh: 折疊桌會移動，是因為星期五布置完成後，沒有人把它收起來存放。

sentences.text: Their problem involved both weak equipment and an unclear maintenance routine.
sentences.zh: 他們的問題同時來自不夠穩固的設備，以及不明確的維護流程。

sentences.text: The team decided to redesign the demonstration instead of simply rebuilding the same arrangement.
sentences.zh: 團隊決定重新設計示範區，而不是照原樣重新搭建。

sentences.text: They transferred every plant into one of the shallow, broad-based recycled boxes donated by their coworkers.
sentences.zh: 他們把每株植物移進同事捐出的低矮回收木箱，每個木箱都有寬大的底座。

sentences.text: Reusable fabric straps connected the containers to weighted platforms without attaching anything to the roof.
sentences.zh: 可重複使用的布帶把容器連接到加重平台，完全沒有將任何東西固定在屋頂上。

sentences.text: Ravi marked space for chairs and tables in an approved roof-access storage room that did not block the emergency exit.
sentences.zh: Ravi 在經核准的屋頂通道儲藏室裡標出桌椅存放空間，並確認不會阻塞緊急出口。

sentences.text: June replaced the missing cardboard sign with a small weatherproof board attached to a heavy stand.
sentences.zh: June 用一塊固定在沉重支架上的小型防水板，取代不見的紙板標示。

sentences.text: Sofia expanded the watering schedule into a checklist covering drains, forecasts, furniture, and plants.
sentences.zh: Sofia 把澆水輪值表擴充成檢查清單，包含排水孔、天氣預報、家具和植物。

sentences.text: Each task had a named volunteer, so responsibility would not disappear between departments.
sentences.zh: 每項工作都有具名志工負責，因此責任不會消失在部門之間。

sentences.text: By eleven thirty, the corner looked simpler than before but considerably safer.
sentences.zh: 到了十一點半，那個角落看起來比以前簡單，卻安全了許多。

sentences.text: When Director Chen arrived, Sofia first explained what had happened and showed her photographs of the wind damage.
sentences.zh: Chen 主管抵達時，Sofia 先解釋事情的經過，並向她展示強風造成損害的照片。

sentences.text: She identified which assumptions had been wrong and how the new design addressed each failure.
sentences.zh: 她指出哪些假設出了錯，以及新設計如何處理每一項失敗。

sentences.text: The director tested a container, examined the storage plan, and read every volunteer's name.
sentences.zh: 主管測試一個容器、查看收納計畫，也讀了每一位志工的名字。

sentences.text: She said the damaged version taught her more than a perfect display would have done.
sentences.zh: 她說，受損的版本帶來的資訊，比完美無缺的展示還要多。

sentences.text: Director Chen approved a three-month trial with weekly safety checks and a strict weight limit.
sentences.zh: Chen 主管批准了三個月的試辦，條件是每週進行安全檢查並嚴守重量限制。

sentences.text: At lunch, employees carried food upstairs and discussed which herbs they could donate next.
sentences.zh: 午餐時，員工帶著食物上樓，討論接下來可以捐出哪些香草植物。

sentences.text: Sofia watched the mint leaves move gently above the traffic in a much lighter breeze.
sentences.zh: Sofia 看著車流上方的薄荷葉，在微弱許多的風中輕輕擺動。

sentences.text: The garden succeeded not because its first design was perfect, but because the team changed it.
sentences.zh: 這座花園能成功，不是因為第一版設計完美，而是因為團隊願意改變它。

questions.q: What did the wind reveal about the original demonstration?
options: Tall items were unstable and the storage routine was unclear
Employees had chosen plants that could not survive outdoors
The roof was too small for six people to use safely

questions.q: Why did Sofia reject the idea of hiding the damage?
options: The director had already seen the rooftop from another building
The damage provided useful information for improving the design
The team did not have enough time to remove the broken items

questions.q: Why did Director Chen approve the three-month trial?
options: The team honestly used the failure to make safety and responsibility clearer
The engineering review had been completed earlier than expected
The employees agreed to pay for permanent construction themselves
